entries.title: Identify customers on purchase orders
entries.description: Linked jobs now show the customer name in the purchase order list and on individual orders, helping you allocate orders without opening each job. Jobs held in stock show “Stock”.

entries.title: Send custom lines before prices are confirmed
entries.description: Send purchase orders with unpriced custom lines, then add their prices when the delivery note or invoice arrives. Part lines still need prices before sending.

entries.title: Track late orders without delivery dates
entries.description: Sent orders without an expected delivery date now become due after 30 days and appear in Late Purchase Orders once overdue.
